entries.definition: marked by calm self-control (especially in trying circumstances); unemotional
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Frames the composure as the sheer absence of nerves, which reads as coldness as readily as courage.
examples: the most nerveless winner in the history of the tournament

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The flat baseline of the family - it names the missing physical strength and stops there, where every sharper member adds an attitude to the same fact.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Turns the missing vigor into something thin and drained, as though what is left had been diluted rather than merely reduced.
examples: an anemic attempt to hit the baseball

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The British spelling, carrying the identical sting - vigor thinned out, not simply lessened.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical in register, presenting the absence of energy as a condition to be observed rather than a failing to be scored.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Technical rather than evaluative - the want of vitality reads as a settled characteristic, not the temporary drain that *enervated* implies.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Implies vitality that was once there and has been taken away, so it asks for sympathy where *lame* asks for scorn.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The vitality has gone slack rather than been broken, leaving a limp, unstrung quality that *debilitated* renders as damage.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The mildest way of falling short - strength barely registering rather than failing, nearer to almost-nothing than to inadequacy.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Harsher than *faint* for the same shortfall - the lack sounds pitiable, and pity here shades into a verdict that it was never going to be enough.

entries.definition: pathetically lacking in force or effectiveness
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Withering - the failure is not merely ineffective but embarrassing, contemptible for having been attempted at all.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The weakness is structural and imminent: the thing will give way under any real pressure.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Cooler and more formal than *flimsy* - there is simply not enough there to be solid, with no promise of collapse attached.
examples: vinyl siding has become the standard-bearer for cheap, insubstantial construction

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Damns the making rather than the thing - it says somebody rushed it or botched it, and the word will not let that go.

entries.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Of light, it reports thin brightness plainly, without the sickliness *pallid* or the melancholy *wan* brings to the same dimness.
examples: the pale light of a half moon
the late afternoon light coming through the el tracks fell in pale oblongs on the street

entries.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Makes the dim light sound drained and washed out, an unwell version of what *pale* states neutrally.

entries.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The weak light sounds dispirited, a dimness with something melancholy in it that *pale* would only measure.

entries.definition: responsible for or chargeable with a reprehensible act
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The family's plain verdict, covering both the one who did the reprehensible act and the one merely chargeable with it - responsibility and accusation under a single word.
